section.title: Books and Reports
section.p: Books on indexing Indexing Books (Mulvany)Indexing Books Facing the Text (Stauber)Facing the Text Hart’s Rules: The Handbook of Style for Writers and Editors (Ritter)Harts Rules Several comprehensive books on indexing are available. Nancy Mulvany’s Indexing Books is considered the definitive work on the subject. Do Mi Stauber’s Facing the Text provides a unique perspective on indexing approaches. Robert Ritter’s Hart’s Rules covers British indexing conventions.

section.title: Journals
section.p: Journals on indexing The Indexer is the international journal of indexing published by the Society of Indexers. Key Words is the bulletin of the American Society of Indexers.

section.title: Organizations
section.p: Indexing organizations American Society of Indexers (ASI) Several professional organizations support indexers worldwide. In North America, the American Society of Indexers (ASI) is the primary professional organization. The British Society of Indexers, the Indexing Society of Canada, the Australian and New Zealand Society of Indexers, and the China Society of Indexers serve their respective regions.

section.title: Indexing Software
section.p: CINDEX MACREX SKY Index Indexing softwareresources The three major dedicated indexing software packages—CINDEX, MACREX, and SKY Index—each offer trial versions and detailed documentation on their respective websites.
